release_policy: Every capability switch is on by default in every release package and is a visible setting the player can turn off. The diagnostic switch is not a feature and is off by default. Only game.loadout.async was seen once in game; nothing else here was run in game.

switches.name: SCO_ACTOR_STATS_WRITE
switches.note: On by default in every release package; a visible setting the player can turn off. The registry says OFF pending in-game confirmation. The release package still sets it on by owner decision; you can turn it off. Not run in game.

switches.name: SCO_AUDIO_NATIVE
switches.note: On by default in every release package; a visible setting the player can turn off. Core currently refuses the native audio adapter even with this on, so both audio capabilities stay off. The switch only asks Core to try. Not run in game.

switches.name: SCO_CVARS_NATIVE
switches.note: On by default in every release package; a visible setting the player can turn off. Not run in game.

switches.name: SCO_INVENTORY_READ
switches.note: On by default in every release package; a visible setting the player can turn off. Not run in game.

switches.name: SCO_LOADOUT_ASYNC
switches.note: On by default in every release package; a visible setting the player can turn off. Seen once in game: gear was attached through the Gear page. See docs/status.md.

diagnostics.name: SCO_ENTITIES_DIAG
diagnostics.note: Installs hooks that patch game functions (the entity streaming functions) only to write log lines, and runs one diagnostic walk that writes to mod.log. Not a capability and no gameplay change. Off by default; turn it on only when asked for a bug report. Not run in game.

not_set_by_launcher.SCO_LOADOUT_OUTFIT: Opens the outfit slots (clothing, hat, head accessory, head horn, jewellery) of game.loadout.outfit on the asynchronous route. The launcher never sets it, so that capability stays off.
